# Defaults

What a new user sees on first start, before any toggle is changed.
Toggles and cyclers are session-only; the palette persists picks and settings in `settings.json` under the data dir.
`mdtation.json` in the working dir can seed Color, Color text decoration and Syntax highlight.

## View menu

### Top section

- Color: on
- Capture mouse: on (`shift+m`)
- Show menu bar: on (`m`)
- Show section crumb: on
- Line caret: `>` (also `+`, `●`)
- Line numbers: off (also absolute, relative)

### Text

- Show text decoration: on
- Color text decoration: on
- Show inline marks: on
- Show links: on

### Blocks

- Show heading marks: on
- Syntax highlight: on
- Show table pipes: on
- Show frontmatter: off
- Code fences: ticks (also fence, hide)
- Blockquote: bar (also `>`, hide)
- Checkbox: `[x]` (also `✓`, `●`, `☑`)

### Prose

- Flow paragraphs: off
- Indent paragraphs: off

## Comments menu

- Copy format: simple (also detailed)

### Options

- Select to comment: on (off means select to copy)
- Archive on copy: off
- Show agent comments inline: on
- Show own comments inline: off

## Settings popup

### View

- Scroll margin: 3 (0 to 10)
- Crumb depth: all (or 1 to 6)
- Inline width: 60 (fit, 50 to 90, full)
- Highlight line: off
- Popup corners: pointy (or round)
- Badge corner: bottom (or top)

### Comments

- Remove after: 30d (1d, 7d, 30d, 1y, never)
- Agent side: left
- Your side: right
- Time: relative (absolute, hide)

### Advanced

- Frontmatter editing: on
